defs.def: a man who is polite and well educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well 彬彬有礼的人；有教养的人；君子

ex.s: The Master said, “A gentleman takes as much trouble to discover what is right as lesser men take to discover what will pay.” Propriety Always behave respectfully towards others.
ex.t: 子曰："君子喻于义，小人喻于利。" 礼 始终恭敬待人。

defs.def: In more informal speech, you could say （称呼或指男子，尤其是不认识的）先生
（对立法机构男议员的称呼）先生，阁下
a man from a high social class, especially one who does not need to work 有身分的人；绅士；富绅

ex.s: A Letter to a Young Gentleman Who Proposes to Embrace the Career of Art Should you or should you not become an artist?
ex.t: 《致一位想从事艺术事业的年轻绅士的信》：你应该还是不应该成为一名艺术家？

ex.s: After his death, I will give the other half to the gentleman who recently stole his daughter.
ex.t: 他死后，我将把另一半给那位最近偷走了他女儿的绅士。

ex.s: I remembered visiting my favourite professor, a tall gentleman with his beard and hair going grey, during his office hours for the first time.
ex.t: 我记得第一次拜访我最喜欢的教授，一位高个子绅士，胡子和头发已渐渐花白，是在他的办公时间。

chunks.cn: 人的）胡须的用以表示或询问高有身分的人
